mx.teacher_note: Laboratory-made elements are neither metals nor non-metals.

intelligence.enrichment: Metals and non-metals are sub-categories of elements, and an element cannot be broken down into simpler substances. Oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen, and carbon are non-metals; plastic, glass, wood, rubber, and paper are materials that are not classified as metals or non-metals. A substance's status as an element determines whether it can be classified as a metal or non-metal in this chapter. The learner correctly applies this rule: Metals and non-metals are sub-categories of elements, and an element cannot be broken down into simpler substances. Oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen, and carbon are non-metals; plastic, glass, wood, rubber, and paper are materials that are not classified as metals or non-metals. Anything that is not a metal should be placed in the non-metal category.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: The world of metals and non-metals. The student must decide: When sorting substances and materials, decide whether something is an element classified as a metal or non-metal or an everyday material that is not in either class. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key.
